single_page_proof: python -m rag.eval.hard check: evidence verbatim in the page; key pattern unique to the page (declared copies aside); loose patterns match the gold page and no page matches all facts' loose patterns; co-mention search over every page, gold pages included (every term of every fact, or every subject phrase, on one page) with each hit read by the author and listed in read_and_cleared with a reason.
